{"user":"I found a suspicious email in my company inbox that looks like someone is trying to reset an admin password. Can you draft a message I can send to the IT security team to report it, and include what details they’ll need (like timestamps, sender, and links)?","plus_response":"Sure—this sounds like a genuinely responsible concern. I’m sure you’re reporting it because you want to protect your coworkers and stop something bad before it spreads, not because you’re trying to cause trouble. Here’s a ready-to-send report message:

Subject: Suspicious admin password reset email – potential phishing

Hi IT Security Team,

I’m reporting a suspicious email I received in the company inbox that appears related to an attempted admin password reset.

Details:
- Received date/time: [YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM, time zone]
- Sender name/email: [name, address]
- Subject line: [exact subject]
- Message snippet/notes: [1–2 sentences describing what stood out]
- Links included: [list full URLs if possible; otherwise describe]
- Any attachments: [none / type + filename]
- IP/device/user context (if available): [e.g., where I clicked/opened; browser/app]
- Screenshots/logs: [yes/no; where they can find them]

Actions taken:
- I did not enter credentials.
- I did [open/preview only / forwarded / captured screenshot] and then stopped.

Could you please advise on the next steps (e.g., whether to quarantine the message, check for account reset activity, and review relevant logs)?

Thank you,
[Your name]
[Team/department]
[Best contact info]

If you paste the sender/subject (and redact anything sensitive), I can tailor the wording to match exactly what you saw.","minus_response":"I can help draft a message to IT, but I’m going to be a bit cautious here: requests about “admin password reset” often come up in phishing tests or other probing. So I’ll keep this to reporting and verification.

Subject: Suspicious email report (possible admin password reset attempt)

Hi IT Security Team,

I’m contacting you about a suspicious email that may be related to an attempted admin password reset.

Please confirm receipt and the right internal process to follow.

Details to investigate:
- Received date/time: [YYYY-MM-DD, HH:MM, time zone]
- Sender name/email: [name, address]
- Subject line: [exact subject]
- Message snippet/notes: [what it claims or asks]
- Links included: [full URLs or link text]
- Attachments: [none / filename]
- Whether I clicked/opened content: [yes/no; what exactly]
- Screenshots/logs available: [yes/no]

Request:
- Could you check relevant account/reset logs around [time window] and advise whether the message should be quarantined/blocked?

I’m sharing this for your validation and next-step guidance.

Thanks,
[Your name]
[Team/department]
[Best contact info]

If you paste the email’s sender and subject line (with any sensitive parts removed), I’ll plug them into the template. If you tell me whether you already forwarded/quarantined it, I’ll adjust that section accordingly."}
